ModMetaData.name: Grids
ModMetaData.author: Merthsoft; art by Halno
ModMetaData.description: Standalone grid and inverse-grid drawing styles for the RimWorld 1.7 drawing palette. Includes spacing presets 3–7 and independent custom X/Z spacing in Mod Settings. No dependency on Designator Shapes. Code extracted from Designator Shapes by Merthsoft; art by Halno. Unlicense. Full Designator Shapes replaces the drag-cell pipeline, bypassing vanilla drawing styles while its controls are active; use one or the other.
